## Summary

Describe the observable change and why it belongs in the Edge Connector.

## Verification

- [ ] `deno task check`
- [ ] `deno task lint`
- [ ] `deno task test`
- [ ] `deno task fmt`
- [ ] `deno task audit`
- [ ] `deno task verify:generated`
- [ ] Documentation, examples, schemas, and generated files match the behavior.
- [ ] Permissions and trust boundaries remain least-privilege and fail closed.
- [ ] No credentials, private keys, customer data, runtime state, or generated
      `.fmx` artifacts are included.
- [ ] New redistributed dependencies include their required license notices.
- [ ] Human-readable names use `FLAMOX365` and `Edge Connector` exactly.
